rubric_hint.rule: contradiction: effort 36 below county median 136 while 1 threatened species are recorded within 1000 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 1.55 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified, with no overlap with completed fellings, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

No eligible species within 1000 m. The only threatened record is Fraxinus excelsior (EN, forest-associated, 307 m, 2016, 100 m uncertainty). The tool lists it as not felling-relevant and not eligible.

Three site-bound forest NT species are recorded, all beyond 250 m (Trichocolea tomentella 797 m, Lecanora glabrata 953 m, Pyrenula nitida 991 m). The 3-NT criterion needs them within 250 m, so it is not met.

Effort is low: 36 records on 13 days within 1000 m, against a county median of 136 (14th percentile). There are 0 records inside the polygon and 0 within 250 m, so the lack of near-site records says little.

The rubric hint is MEDIUM because of an unresolved contradiction: effort is below the county median while a threatened species is recorded within 1000 m. I kept this hint. The threatened species is forest-associated, so the tool output does not show it to be irrelevant to the stand.

contradictions.claim: Effort is below the county median, yet a threatened forest-associated species (Fraxinus excelsior, EN) is recorded within 1000 m. The tool marks it as not felling-relevant.

uncertainties: Low recording effort means the lack of eligible species near the site may reflect few observers, not absence of species.
The only threatened record dates from 2016 and has 100 m uncertainty. 11 further records were dropped for uncertainty.
If a reviewer judges the Fraxinus record irrelevant to the stand, the site would fall to UNDER_SURVEYED, not LOW, because effort is below the median.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
Stand age, habitat quality or dead wood.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should do a field or desk check of the stand for old trees and continuity-forest values, since near-site recording is absent. The reviewer should also decide whether the Fraxinus excelsior record resolves the contradiction.
